name: LEPU ScienTech Medical Technology (Shanghai) Co., Ltd.
summary: LEPU ScienTech Medical Technology (Shanghai) Co., Ltd., an investment holding company, engages in the manufacture and sale of interventional treatment series occluders and heart valve medical devices. It operates through Occluder Business and Heart Valve Business segments. The company also researches, develops, manufacture, and sale interventional treatment series occluders for defective congenital heart disease; and manufacture and sale heart valve medical devices. Its products include atrial septal defect, ventricular septal defect, patent ductus arteriosus, patent foramen ovale, left atrial appendage, and aortic and peripheral occluders, as well as aortic and mitral valve occluder product…
